repaired.name: Scenario

diagnosis.summary: The IR requires a 1-minute (60,000 ms) sustained wait before the action. The candidate uses a 1000 ms wrapper period and a threshold of 60 ticks. With period=1000, 60 ticks equals only 60 seconds, causing the action to fire 30 seconds early. Furthermore, the 1000 ms wrapper cannot detect the condition dropping and returning within the 1-minute window, violating the 'sustain' requirement.
diagnosis.change_summary: Changed the wrapper period to 100 ms and the threshold to 601 ticks (representing 60 seconds + 1 initial tick). This ensures the action fires exactly after 60 seconds of continuous true input, matching the IR's 1-minute duration.
